To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the gain medium dispersion has a significant impact on stability of solitons in fiber lasers.

(1) gain medium dispersion plays a key role for the formation of bound state soliton in fiber lasers; (2) gain medium supporting soliton formation leads to bunching in the cavity; (3) gain medium with normal dispersion leads to stationary bound state solitons; (4) the results provide guidelines for synthesis of dispersion map for solitons in fiber lasers.
the dispersion of the gain medium has a strong effect on the stability of bound soliton states in fiber lasers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the stability of solitons bound states in fiber lasers.
the study of solitons and soliton interactions in fiber lasers.
the study of the effect of the gain medium group dispersion on stability of bound state solitons in fiber laser.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
soliton bound states in fiber lasers are stable and robust, provided that a proper dispersion map is chosen.
the soliton bound states can be generated only in a fiber with normal non-solitonic dispersion, and the soliton bound state is not a stable state in the fiber with normal non-linear dispersion.
soliton bound states can be formed in fiber laser only in the presence of a bi-temporal saturating absorber.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the gain media dispersion has a strong impact on stability of solitons in fiber laser.
soliton bound states are stable and robust in fiber lasers with gain media supporting soliton generation.
the dispersion map of fiber laser is an important parameter for the soliton generation.

the gain media dispersion plays a key role in the formation of soliton clusters and can be used to control the dynamics of the bound solitons.
the soliton interaction is enhanced by the attractive force produced by bitemporal gain media.
